display_long_description:
**The Official VR Golf game of the PGA TOUR**

Now with **Immersive Putting**: Real putter. Real ball. The most fun you’ll ever have putting at home (Quest 3/3S, GOLF+ PASS required).                                                                                                        

[media]

# GOLF+ Includes:
**Immersive Putting:** Putting practice that feels like a game. The headset blends a full putting green into any room. Every putt is captured and measured. See your make % and strokes gained by distance against scratch and tour benchmarks so practice turns into real improvement. 
[media]

**⛳️ Iconic Courses**: 3 Free Courses and over 50 real-world destinations available for purchase including Pebble Beach, The Old Course at St Andrews, TPC Sawgrass.
[media]

**🏆 Competitive Play**: Climb the ranks and compete globally on the GOLF+ TOUR in both VR and Immersive Putting.

[media]

**🏌️Multiplayer**: Play with your circle of friends, or join public rounds and connect with golf enthusiasts worldwide. Players can wager and win in-game currency, which cannot be transferred, exported, or redeemed for real-world value.
[media]


**✅ Real Golf Brands**: Experience golf equipment from leading brands like TaylorMade, Callaway and PXG.
[media]

**📈 Performance Feedback**: Advanced shot and putt stats, strokes gained, handicap system, and swing analyzer to help you understand and improve your game.
[media]

**🎯 Diverse Modes**: From Match Play and Scramble to Weekly Challenges and 1v1 Battle Mode.

**🏞 Practice Facility**: A place to practice, fine tune your clubs, and get dialed in.
